<mxfile host="Electron"> <diagram id="collection-center" name="Collection Center Network Pattern"> <mxGraphModel grid="0" gridSize="10" guides="1" tooltips="1" connect="1" arrows="1" fold="0" page="0" pageScale="1" pageWidth="3600" pageHeight="2350" math="0" shadow="0"> <root> <mxCell id="0" /> <mxCell id="1" parent="0" /> <mxCell id="title" parent="1" style="text;html=1;align=left;verticalAlign=middle;fontSize=28;fontStyle=1;fontColor=#102a43;" value="Collection Center Network Pattern (10.4x.0.0/16)" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="45" width="3480" x="40" y="20" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="subtitle" parent="1" style="text;html=1;align=left;verticalAlign=middle;fontSize=15;fontColor=#334e68;" value="One repeatable pattern deployed across three centers: Cauca (10.41.0.0/16), Huila (10.42.0.0/16), Tolima (10.43.0.0/16) inside 10.40.0.0/13. Shows zones, VLANs, SSIDs, perimeter firewall [D07], uplinks to hub [D05], production VPC tiers [D04], offline logistics, code-sheet printing, and inter-zone policy intent." vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="40" width="3480" x="40" y="65" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="card_params" parent="1" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#f0f4f8;strokeColor=#627d98;strokeWidth=1;fontColor=#102a43;fontSize=13;align=left;verticalAlign=top;spacing=10;fontStyle=0;" value="CENTER PARAMETERS
- Pattern CIDR: 10.4x.0.0/16 within 10.40.0.0/13
- Cauca: 10.41.0.0/16 | Huila: 10.42.0.0/16 | Tolima: 10.43.0.0/16
- Summary Route: 10.40.0.0/13 routed via AWS Transit Gateway
- Authority: docs/collection-center-network.md & docs/addressing-plan.md" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="100" width="620" x="40" y="115" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="card_wan" parent="1" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#f0f4f8;strokeColor=#627d98;strokeWidth=1;fontColor=#102a43;fontSize=13;align=left;verticalAlign=top;spacing=10;fontStyle=0;" value="WAN & TRAFFIC CLASSES (ASM-084..086)
- Primary WAN: 100 Mbps symmetric (90M planned + 10M IPsec/control)
- Backup: Cellular LTE+ auto-failover; non-operational traffic dropped
- QoS P1: Network control (2/2M gtd) | P2: Logistics (44/11M gtd)
- QoS P3: Drone (5/20M gtd) | P4: Staff (28/7M gtd) | P5: Non-op (capped)" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="100" width="680" x="680" y="115" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="card_trace" parent="1" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#f0f4f8;strokeColor=#627d98;strokeWidth=1;fontColor=#102a43;fontSize=13;align=left;verticalAlign=top;spacing=10;fontStyle=0;" value="TRACEABILITY & IAC BOXES (architecture.md sec 14, ASM-200)
- [D05] Association of Environment with Pattern Center (B05: TGW hub & VPN)
- [D07] Pattern Firewall Rules (B07: Perimeter firewall rule set CC-01..CC-DEF)
- [D04] VPC Tiers of Pattern Environment (B04: Production VPC pdn 10.82.0.0/16)
- Decisions: ASM-080..089, PD-090..096, ASM-079, ASM-124, ASM-140" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="100" width="760" x="1380" y="115" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="card_legend" parent="1" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#f0f4f8;strokeColor=#627d98;strokeWidth=1;fontColor=#102a43;fontSize=13;align=left;verticalAlign=top;spacing=10;fontStyle=0;" value="POLICY INTENT LEGEND
- Solid Green Arrow: Allowed Flow (Stateful rule, port & rule ID labeled)
- Dashed Red Arrow: Denied Flow (Explicit firewall deny / blackhole)
- Blue Line: Physical Uplink / 802.1Q VLAN Trunk
- Client Isolation: Enabled on cc-transport & cc-guest SSIDs" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="100" width="660" x="2160" y="115" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="card_resilience" parent="1" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#f0f4f8;strokeColor=#627d98;strokeWidth=1;fontColor=#102a43;fontSize=13;align=left;verticalAlign=top;spacing=10;fontStyle=0;" value="OFFLINE OPERATION GUARANTEE (ASM-079, ASM-124)
- WAN Down: Logistics reception app persists to local encrypted outbox
- Local Printing: Code sheets print locally over LAN (never crosses WAN)
- Local Auth: RADIUS runs on firewall with cached CRL chain
- Automatic Drain: Outbox drains to AWS application tier upon link recovery" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="100" width="680" x="2840" y="115" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="site_cc" parent="1" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#f8fafc;strokeColor=#334e68;strokeWidth=3;fontColor=#102a43;fontSize=16;fontStyle=1;align=left;verticalAlign=top;spacing=15;" value="COLLECTION CENTER SITE BOUNDARY | Parameterized Network 10.4x.0.0/16 (Summary: 10.40.0.0/13)
[Repeatable Pattern for Cauca 10.41.0.0/16, Huila 10.42.0.0/16, Tolima 10.43.0.0/16]" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="2085" width="2100" x="40" y="235" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="zone_cloudlink" parent="1" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#f1f5f9;strokeColor=#64748b;strokeWidth=2;fontColor=#0f172a;fontSize=14;fontStyle=1;align=left;verticalAlign=top;spacing=10;" value="ENLACE A LA NUBE (Cloud Link) | VLAN 120 | 10.4x.20.0/24
Wired only on firewall edge ports (never bridged to switch trunk, ASM-088)" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="370" width="600" x="70" y="300" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="node_fw_edge" parent="1" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#ffffff;strokeColor=#475569;strokeWidth=2;fontColor=#0f172a;fontSize=13;fontStyle=1;align=center;verticalAlign=middle;" value="Firewall Edge Interface
10.4x.20.1
(Source IP toward Hub)" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="85" width="210" x="90" y="365" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="node_isp_pri" parent="1" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#ffffff;strokeColor=#0284c7;strokeWidth=2;fontColor=#0369a1;fontSize=13;fontStyle=1;align=center;verticalAlign=middle;" value="Primary WAN Equipment
10.4x.20.2
100 Mbps Symmetric Fiber
(Internet Service LAN side)" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="85" width="240" x="410" y="365" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="node_isp_bak" parent="1" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#ffffff;strokeColor=#0284c7;strokeWidth=2;fontColor=#0369a1;fontSize=13;fontStyle=1;align=center;verticalAlign=middle;" value="Cellular Backup Router
10.4x.20.3
LTE+ Backup Link
(Auto-failover on WAN loss)" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="85" width="240" x="410" y="485" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="note_cloudlink" parent="1" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#ffffff;strokeColor=#94a3b8;strokeWidth=1;fontColor=#475569;fontSize=12;align=left;verticalAlign=middle;spacing=8;" value="Edge rule: 10.4x.20.0/24 never bridged into switch trunk.
Provider public IPs are external; WAN failover activates backup tunnel." vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="55" width="560" x="90" y="600" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="node_firewall" parent="1" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#ffffff;strokeColor=#dc2626;strokeWidth=3;fontColor=#991b1b;fontSize=13;fontStyle=0;align=left;verticalAlign=top;spacing=12;" value="PERIMETER FIREWALL APPLIANCE [D07]
Edge: 10.4x.20.1 | Mgmt: 10.4x.10.1 | Gateways: 10.4x.Z.1
- Stateful Zone Inspection: Rules CC-01 to CC-DEF (firewall-policy.md sec 4)
- Dual IPsec VPN Tunnels: UDP 500 / 4500 NAT-T, IP 50 ESP to AWS Hub
- Subinterfaces: .1 default gateway for VLANs 101-105 and 110
- Gateway Services: DHCP server & DNS conditional forwarder (.1)
- Local RADIUS Server: 802.1X EAP-TLS with cached CRL for offline auth
- QoS Traffic Shaper: Priority 1 to 5 bandwidth guarantees and caps
- Dual Contexts: Internal LAN context vs Internet-only routing context" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="370" width="710" x="700" y="300" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="badge_d07" parent="1" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#dc2626;strokeColor=#991b1b;fontColor=#ffffff;fontSize=12;fontStyle=1;align=center;verticalAlign=middle;" value="[D07] Pattern Firewall Rules" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="28" width="230" x="1160" y="310" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="node_switch_box" parent="1" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#ffffff;strokeColor=#2563eb;strokeWidth=2;fontColor=#1e40af;fontSize=13;fontStyle=0;align=left;verticalAlign=top;spacing=10;" value="MANAGED PoE ACCESS SWITCH (VLAN 110)
Management: 10.4x.10.2 to .9 | Static assignment
- 802.1Q Trunk from firewall on dedicated access trunk port
- Access ports with 802.1X EAP-TLS port admission for staff
- MAC-based port security for Code-Sheet Printers (ASM-124)
- Layer 2 only: does not route; switches only carry VLAN tags (ASM-080)" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="180" width="680" x="1440" y="300" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="node_aps_box" parent="1" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#ffffff;strokeColor=#2563eb;strokeWidth=2;fontColor=#1e40af;fontSize=13;fontStyle=0;align=left;verticalAlign=top;spacing=10;" value="MANAGED Wi-Fi ACCESS POINTS (VLAN 110)
Management: 10.4x.10.20 to .49 | DHCP reservation by MAC
- 5 SSIDs broadcast per radio (cc-management, cc-support, cc-logistics, cc-transport, cc-guest)
- WPA3-Enterprise (802.1X EAP-TLS) for staff zones; WPA3-Personal (SAE) for guests
- Client Isolation enforced on cc-transport & cc-guest SSIDs (ASM-081)" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="170" width="680" x="1440" y="500" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="zone_gerencia" parent="1" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#ffffff;strokeColor=#475569;strokeWidth=2;fontColor=#0f172a;fontSize=13;align=left;verticalAlign=top;spacing=12;" value="GERENCIA (Management) | VLAN 101 | 10.4x.1.0/24
SSID: cc-management | WPA3-Enterprise (802.1X EAP-TLS)
- Gateway: 10.4x.1.1 on Firewall subinterface
- DHCP Pool: 10.4x.1.50 to .69 (20 hosts, lease 12 h)
- Planned Clients: 2 wired desktops, 5 Wi-Fi phones (7 clients)
- Traffic Class: Staff (Priority 4, 28/7 Mbps guaranteed)
- Allowed Flows: Cloud app (CC-STF-01), Printers (CC-STF-02), Web breakout (CC-STF-04)
- DENIED: Inter-zone to Soporte, Logística, Guests [CC-STF-03]" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="470" width="600" x="70" y="710" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="zone_servidores" parent="1" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#ffffff;strokeColor=#475569;strokeWidth=2;fontColor=#0f172a;fontSize=13;align=left;verticalAlign=top;spacing=12;" value="SERVIDORES LOCALES (Local Servers) | VLAN 110 | 10.4x.10.0/24
Wired only (no SSID) | Gateway: 10.4x.10.1 (Firewall mgmt)
- Addressing: Switches .2-.9, APs .20-.49 (DHCP reservations)
- Dynamic DHCP: NONE; unreserved ports receive no IP
- Traffic Class: Network Control (Priority 1, 2/2 Mbps guaranteed)
- Ingress Administration: Accepted ONLY from Cloud administration tier [CC-ADM-01]
- DENIED: General internet [CC-ADM-07]; clients cannot reach mgmt [CC-ADM-03]" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="470" width="710" x="700" y="710" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="node_printers" parent="1" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#f0fdf4;strokeColor=#16a34a;strokeWidth=2;fontColor=#14532d;fontSize=12;align=left;verticalAlign=top;spacing=10;fontStyle=0;" value="Code-Sheet Network Printers: 10.4x.10.50 to .59 (Static IP)
Two network printers wired to PoE switch with MAC port security (ASM-124)
- Printed from Logística (TCP 631 IPP) for un-coded sacks [CC-LOG-02]
- Printed from Gerencia & Soporte (TCP 631 IPP) [CC-STF-02]
- Local print traffic never crosses WAN; operates offline (ASM-124)
- Printers NEVER initiate connections to user zones, cloud, or internet [CC-ADM-04]" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="220" width="670" x="720" y="940" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="zone_soporte" parent="1" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#ffffff;strokeColor=#475569;strokeWidth=2;fontColor=#0f172a;fontSize=13;align=left;verticalAlign=top;spacing=12;" value="SOPORTE (Support) | VLAN 102 | 10.4x.2.0/24
SSID: cc-support | WPA3-Enterprise (802.1X EAP-TLS)
- Gateway: 10.4x.2.1 on Firewall subinterface
- DHCP Pool: 10.4x.2.50 to .69 (20 hosts, lease 12 h)
- Planned Clients: 2 wired desktops, 5 Wi-Fi phones (7 clients)
- Traffic Class: Staff (Priority 4) & Drone Class (Priority 3, 5/20 Mbps gtd)
- Allowed Flows: Cloud app (CC-STF-01), Printers (CC-STF-02), Web breakout (CC-STF-04)
- DENIED: Inter-zone to Gerencia, Logística, Guests [CC-STF-03]" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="470" width="680" x="1440" y="710" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="node_drone_station" parent="1" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#fef3c7;strokeColor=#d97706;strokeWidth=2;fontColor=#78350f;fontSize=12;align=left;verticalAlign=top;spacing=10;fontStyle=0;" value="Drone Ground Station: 10.4x.2.10/32 (Fixed DHCP Reservation)
Contracted operator device (ADR-002, ASM-082) with private client certificate
- To Cloud application (TCP 443): mission preload & upload grant [CC-DRN-01]
- To Cloud object_storage S3 (TCP 443): multipart flight upload [CC-DRN-03]
- To AWS IoT Core (TCP 8883): MQTT grant topic via breakout [CC-DRN-04]
- DENIED: drone_object_ingress tier (reserved, ASM-140) [CC-DRN-02]
- DENIED: Any other destination [CC-DRN-05]; rest of Soporte denied drone paths [CC-DRN-06]" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="220" width="640" x="1460" y="940" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="zone_logistica" parent="1" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#ffffff;strokeColor=#475569;strokeWidth=2;fontColor=#0f172a;fontSize=13;align=left;verticalAlign=top;spacing=12;" value="LOGÍSTICA (Logistics Yard & Reception) | VLAN 103 | 10.4x.3.0/24
SSID: cc-logistics | WPA3-Enterprise (802.1X EAP-TLS)
- Gateway: 10.4x.3.1 on Firewall subinterface
- DHCP Pool: 10.4x.3.50 to .99 (50 hosts, lease 12 h)
- Planned Clients: 2 wired desktops, 20 handheld phones (22 clients)
- Traffic Class: Logistics (Priority 2, 44/11 Mbps guaranteed)
- Allowed Flows: Cloud app (CC-LOG-01), Code-Sheet Printers (CC-LOG-02)
- DENIED: General internet [CC-LOG-04]; inter-zone to other client zones" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="480" width="600" x="70" y="1220" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="node_reception_posts" parent="1" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#eff6ff;strokeColor=#3b82f6;strokeWidth=2;fontColor=#1e3a8a;fontSize=12;align=left;verticalAlign=top;spacing=8;fontStyle=0;" value="Reception Workstations: 10.4x.3.2 & 10.4x.3.3 (Wired 802.1X)
Two receiving posts running Part C collection app with operator MFA
- Registers sack arrivals, acceptance/rejection, and trips
- Encrypted Local Outbox (ASM-079): holds records during WAN outages
- Sends print requests locally to Code-Sheet Printers (TCP 631) [CC-LOG-02]
- Drains outbox automatically to AWS application tier upon link recovery" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="130" width="570" x="85" y="1430" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="node_scanners" parent="1" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#eff6ff;strokeColor=#3b82f6;strokeWidth=1.5;fontColor=#1e3a8a;fontSize=12;align=left;verticalAlign=top;spacing=8;fontStyle=0;" value="Logistics Yard Handheld Scanners: 20 Wi-Fi Phones (10.4x.3.50-.99)
Joined to cc-logistics SSID with 802.1X EAP-TLS device certificates
- Yard operators scan barcode / code-sheet on coffee sacks
- Reaches AWS application tier via tunnel [CC-LOG-01]" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="105" width="570" x="85" y="1575" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="zone_transporte" parent="1" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#ffffff;strokeColor=#475569;strokeWidth=2;fontColor=#0f172a;fontSize=13;align=left;verticalAlign=top;spacing=12;" value="TRANSPORTE (Transport) | VLAN 104 | 10.4x.4.0/24
SSID: cc-transport | WPA3-Personal (SAE, rotated per harvest)
- Gateway: 10.4x.4.1 on Firewall subinterface
- DHCP Pool: 10.4x.4.50 to .89 (40 hosts, lease 4 h) | 20 planned phones
- Client Isolation: ENABLED (phone-to-phone communication blocked)
- Routing Context: INTERNET-ONLY CONTEXT (no route to 10.4x, 10.40.0.0/13 or tunnel)
- Traffic Classes: Transport App (2/1M gtd) & Non-operational (20/5M capped)
- Allowed Flows: Public API front door (CC-TEL-02) & Sack lookup (CC-PUB-01)
- DENIED: Internal LAN & Cloud tiers [CC-GST-02, CC-GST-03], SMTP 25 [CC-GST-04]" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="480" width="710" x="700" y="1220" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="node_transporte_detail" parent="1" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#f8fafc;strokeColor=#64748b;strokeWidth=1.5;fontColor=#0f172a;fontSize=12;align=left;verticalAlign=top;spacing=10;" value="Transporter Operational Context:
- Registered drivers transmit custody transfer events and GPS positions
- Driver phones exit strictly via local internet breakout to Public API front door
- Never permitted to reach internal logistics workstations or servers
- Protected against spoofing and lateral movement via wireless client isolation" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="200" width="670" x="720" y="1480" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="zone_visitantes" parent="1" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#ffffff;strokeColor=#475569;strokeWidth=2;fontColor=#0f172a;fontSize=13;align=left;verticalAlign=top;spacing=12;" value="VISITANTES (Visitors / Guests) | VLAN 105 | 10.4x.5.0/24
SSID: cc-guest | WPA3-Personal (SAE, weekly rotated passphrase at reception)
- Gateway: 10.4x.5.1 on Firewall subinterface
- DHCP Pool: 10.4x.5.50 to .69 (20 hosts, lease 1 h) | 10 planned phones
- Client Isolation: ENABLED (guest-to-guest communication blocked)
- Routing Context: INTERNET-ONLY CONTEXT (no route to 10.4x, 10.40.0.0/13 or tunnel)
- Traffic Class: Non-operational (Priority 5, capped at 10/2.5M, 2/0.5M/client, ASM-125)
- Allowed Flows: Local breakout web [CC-GST-05], Public Sack Lookup [CC-PUB-01]
- DENIED: Internal LAN & Cloud tiers [CC-GST-01, CC-GST-03], SMTP 25 [CC-GST-04]" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="480" width="680" x="1440" y="1220" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="node_guest_detail" parent="1" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#f8fafc;strokeColor=#64748b;strokeWidth=1.5;fontColor=#0f172a;fontSize=12;align=left;verticalAlign=top;spacing=10;" value="Guest Isolation Context (Case Statement Requirement):
- "La VLAN de visitantes no enruta hacia logística ni gerencia" (CC-GST-01)
- Enforced at Layer 3: Internet-only routing context has no routes to 10.4x
- Enforced at Layer 4: Perimeter firewall explicit deny rules CC-GST-01..03
- Enforced at Layer 2: Wi-Fi client isolation prevents guest-to-guest visibility" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="200" width="640" x="1460" y="1480" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="panel_matrix" parent="1" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#ffffff;strokeColor=#475569;strokeWidth=2;fontColor=#0f172a;fontSize=13;align=left;verticalAlign=top;spacing=12;" value="INTER-ZONE POLICY INTENT MATRIX SUMMARY (firewall-policy.md sec 4 & collection-center-network.md sec 6)
Enforced statefully by Perimeter Firewall Appliance [D07]:
- Gerencia (101): Deny other LAN | Allow Printers (631) | Allow Cloud App (443 via Tunnel) | Allow Internet Web Breakout
- Soporte (102): Deny other LAN | Allow Printers (631) | Allow Cloud App (443 via Tunnel) | Allow Internet Web Breakout
- Soporte Drone .10: Allow Cloud App (443) & S3 Object Storage (443) | Allow IoT Core (8883) | DENIED drone_object_ingress
- Logística (103): Deny other LAN | Allow Printers (631) | Allow Cloud App (443 via Tunnel) | DENIED General Internet (no breakout)
- Transporte (104): Client Isolation | Deny Internal LAN & Tunnel | Allow Public API Front Door (443) & Lookup (443)
- Visitantes (105): Client Isolation | Deny Internal LAN & Tunnel | Allow Non-Op Web Breakout (capped) & Lookup (443)
- Servidores (110): Deny Inter-device | Accept Mgmt from Cloud Admin (22/443) | DENIED General Internet | Printers never initiate
- Inbound WAN: DENIED all inbound connection initiations from Internet or Cloud to Center LAN (CC-LNK-07, CC-LNK-08)" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="510" width="1340" x="70" y="1785" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="panel_security" parent="1" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#ffffff;strokeColor=#475569;strokeWidth=2;fontColor=#0f172a;fontSize=13;align=left;verticalAlign=top;spacing=12;" value="SECURITY & ZERO-TRUST CONTROLS (ASM-080..089, PD-090..096)
- 802.1X Network Admission: EAP-TLS certificate auth for staff laptops, workstations, and drone station
- RADIUS Local CRL: Firewall caches certificate revocation list; validates certs locally without WAN
- Printer Hardening: Static IPs, MAC port security, print-only ingress (IPP 631); cannot initiate flows (CC-ADM-04)
- Reception Posts: Dedicated physical cable; local encrypted outbox stores Part C arrivals when offline
- Transporter & Guest Isolation: WPA3-Personal SAE, wireless client isolation, internet-only routing context
- Cloud Management Ingress: Cloud operators enter AWS via IAM Identity Center MFA; session host to center mgmt
- Drone Upload Isolation: Dedicated /32 reservation (10.4x.2.10) restricted to S3 endpoint; no drone ingress endpoint" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="510" width="680" x="1440" y="1785" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="box_hub" parent="1" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#ede2fe;strokeColor=#7c3aed;strokeWidth=3;fontColor=#4c1d95;fontSize=16;fontStyle=1;align=left;verticalAlign=top;spacing=12;" value="AWS NETWORK ACCOUNT HUB | us-east-1" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="275" width="1020" x="2540" y="235" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="badge_d05" parent="1" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#7c3aed;strokeColor=#5b21b6;fontColor=#ffffff;fontSize=12;fontStyle=1;align=center;verticalAlign=middle;" value="[D05] Association with Pattern Center" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="30" width="290" x="3250" y="245" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="node_tgw_hub" parent="1" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#ffffff;strokeColor=#8c4fff;strokeWidth=2;fontColor=#3b0764;fontSize=13;align=left;verticalAlign=top;spacing=10;" value="AWS Transit Gateway Hub (tgw-hub)
- Central hub for collection-center connectivity and cross-account routing
- Static routing: 10.4x.0.0/16 only; cannot be widened by center firewall (CL-LNK-06)
- Route Table 'centers': static routes to pdn VPC tiers; all other 10.80.0.0/13 blackholed
- Hub carries no center-to-center path (CL-LNK-02, CC-LNK-09)" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="195" width="665" x="2565" y="290" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="icon_tgw" parent="1" style="outlineConnect=0;fontColor=#232F3E;fillColor=#8C4FFF;strokeColor=#ffffff;dashed=0;verticalLabelPosition=bottom;verticalAlign=top;align=center;html=1;fontSize=12;aspect=fixed;shape=mxgraph.aws4.resourceIcon;resIcon=mxgraph.aws4.transit_gateway;" value="" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="60" width="60" x="3160" y="395" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="node_vpn_hub" parent="1" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#ffffff;strokeColor=#8c4fff;strokeWidth=2;fontColor=#3b0764;fontSize=12;align=left;verticalAlign=top;spacing=8;" value="Site-to-Site VPN Connection

div.div: One repeatable pattern deployed across three centers: Cauca (10.41.0.0/16), Huila (10.42.0.0/16), Tolima (10.43.0.0/16) inside 10.40.0.0/13. Shows zones, VLANs, SSIDs, perimeter firewall [D07], uplinks to hub [D05], production VPC tiers [D04], offline logistics, code-sheet printing, and inter-zone policy intent.

CENTER PARAMETERS
- Pattern CIDR: 10.4x.0.0/16 within 10.40.0.0/13
- Cauca: 10.41.0.0/16 | Huila: 10.42.0.0/16 | Tolima: 10.43.0.0/16
- Summary Route: 10.40.0.0/13 routed via AWS Transit Gateway
- Authority: docs/collection-center-network.md & docs/addressing-plan.md

div.div:
WAN & TRAFFIC CLASSES (ASM-084..086)
- Primary WAN: 100 Mbps symmetric (90M planned + 10M IPsec/control)
- Backup: Cellular LTE+ auto-failover; non-operational traffic dropped
- QoS P1: Network control (2/2M gtd) | P2: Logistics (44/11M gtd)
- QoS P3: Drone (5/20M gtd) | P4: Staff (28/7M gtd) | P5: Non-op (capped)

- [D05] Association of Environment with Pattern Center (B05: TGW hub & VPN)
- [D07] Pattern Firewall Rules (B07: Perimeter firewall rule set CC-01..CC-DEF)
- [D04] VPC Tiers of Pattern Environment (B04: Production VPC pdn 10.82.0.0/16)
- Decisions: ASM-080..089, PD-090..096, ASM-079, ASM-124, ASM-140

POLICY INTENT LEGEND
- Solid Green Arrow: Allowed Flow (Stateful rule, port & rule ID labeled)
- Dashed Red Arrow: Denied Flow (Explicit firewall deny / blackhole)
- Blue Line: Physical Uplink / 802.1Q VLAN Trunk
- Client Isolation: Enabled on cc-transport & cc-guest SSIDs

div.div:
OFFLINE OPERATION GUARANTEE (ASM-079, ASM-124)
- WAN Down: Logistics reception app persists to local encrypted outbox
- Local Printing: Code sheets print locally over LAN (never crosses WAN)
- Local Auth: RADIUS runs on firewall with cached CRL chain
- Automatic Drain: Outbox drains to AWS application tier upon link recovery

div.div:
PERIMETER FIREWALL APPLIANCE [D07]
Edge: 10.4x.20.1 | Mgmt: 10.4x.10.1 | Gateways: 10.4x.Z.1
- Stateful Zone Inspection: Rules CC-01 to CC-DEF (firewall-policy.md sec 4)
- Dual IPsec VPN Tunnels: UDP 500 / 4500 NAT-T, IP 50 ESP to AWS Hub
- Subinterfaces: .1 default gateway for VLANs 101-105 and 110
- Gateway Services: DHCP server & DNS conditional forwarder (.1)
- Local RADIUS Server: 802.1X EAP-TLS with cached CRL for offline auth
- QoS Traffic Shaper: Priority 1 to 5 bandwidth guarantees and caps
- Dual Contexts: Internal LAN context vs Internet-only routing context

div.div:
MANAGED PoE ACCESS SWITCH (VLAN 110)
Management: 10.4x.10.2 to .9 | Static assignment
- 802.1Q Trunk from firewall on dedicated access trunk port
- Access ports with 802.1X EAP-TLS port admission for staff
- MAC-based port security for Code-Sheet Printers (ASM-124)
- Layer 2 only: does not route; switches only carry VLAN tags (ASM-080)

div.div:
MANAGED Wi-Fi ACCESS POINTS (VLAN 110)
Management: 10.4x.10.20 to .49 | DHCP reservation by MAC
- 5 SSIDs broadcast per radio (cc-management, cc-support, cc-logistics, cc-transport, cc-guest)
- WPA3-Enterprise (802.1X EAP-TLS) for staff zones; WPA3-Personal (SAE) for guests
- Client Isolation enforced on cc-transport & cc-guest SSIDs (ASM-081)

div.div:
GERENCIA (Management) | VLAN 101 | 10.4x.1.0/24
SSID: cc-management | WPA3-Enterprise (802.1X EAP-TLS)
- Gateway: 10.4x.1.1 on Firewall subinterface
- DHCP Pool: 10.4x.1.50 to .69 (20 hosts, lease 12 h)
- Planned Clients: 2 wired desktops, 5 Wi-Fi phones (7 clients)
- Traffic Class: Staff (Priority 4, 28/7 Mbps guaranteed)
- Allowed Flows: Cloud app (CC-STF-01), Printers (CC-STF-02), Web breakout (CC-STF-04)
- DENIED: Inter-zone to Soporte, Logística, Guests [CC-STF-03]

div.div:
SERVIDORES LOCALES (Local Servers) | VLAN 110 | 10.4x.10.0/24
Wired only (no SSID) | Gateway: 10.4x.10.1 (Firewall mgmt)
- Addressing: Switches .2-.9, APs .20-.49 (DHCP reservations)
- Dynamic DHCP: NONE; unreserved ports receive no IP
- Traffic Class: Network Control (Priority 1, 2/2 Mbps guaranteed)
- Ingress Administration: Accepted ONLY from Cloud administration tier [CC-ADM-01]
- DENIED: General internet [CC-ADM-07]; clients cannot reach mgmt [CC-ADM-03]

div.div:
Code-Sheet Network Printers: 10.4x.10.50 to .59 (Static IP)
Two network printers wired to PoE switch with MAC port security (ASM-124)
- Printed from Logística (TCP 631 IPP) for un-coded sacks [CC-LOG-02]
- Printed from Gerencia & Soporte (TCP 631 IPP) [CC-STF-02]
- Local print traffic never crosses WAN; operates offline (ASM-124)
- Printers NEVER initiate connections to user zones, cloud, or internet [CC-ADM-04]

div.div:
INTER-ZONE POLICY INTENT MATRIX SUMMARY (firewall-policy.md sec 4 & collection-center-network.md sec 6)
Enforced statefully by Perimeter Firewall Appliance [D07]:
- Gerencia (101): Deny other LAN | Allow Printers (631) | Allow Cloud App (443 via Tunnel) | Allow Internet Web Breakout
- Soporte (102): Deny other LAN | Allow Printers (631) | Allow Cloud App (443 via Tunnel) | Allow Internet Web Breakout
- Soporte Drone .10: Allow Cloud App (443) & S3 Object Storage (443) | Allow IoT Core (8883) | DENIED drone_object_ingress
- Logística (103): Deny other LAN | Allow Printers (631) | Allow Cloud App (443 via Tunnel) | DENIED General Internet (no breakout)
- Transporte (104): Client Isolation | Deny Internal LAN & Tunnel | Allow Public API Front Door (443) & Lookup (443)
- Visitantes (105): Client Isolation | Deny Internal LAN & Tunnel | Allow Non-Op Web Breakout (capped) & Lookup (443)
- Servidores (110): Deny Inter-device | Accept Mgmt from Cloud Admin (22/443) | DENIED General Internet | Printers never initiate
- Inbound WAN: DENIED all inbound connection initiations from Internet or Cloud to Center LAN (CC-LNK-07, CC-LNK-08)

div.div:
SECURITY & ZERO-TRUST CONTROLS (ASM-080..089, PD-090..096)
- 802.1X Network Admission: EAP-TLS certificate auth for staff laptops, workstations, and drone station
- RADIUS Local CRL: Firewall caches certificate revocation list; validates certs locally without WAN
- Printer Hardening: Static IPs, MAC port security, print-only ingress (IPP 631); cannot initiate flows (CC-ADM-04)
- Reception Posts: Dedicated physical cable; local encrypted outbox stores Part C arrivals when offline
- Transporter & Guest Isolation: WPA3-Personal SAE, wireless client isolation, internet-only routing context
- Cloud Management Ingress: Cloud operators enter AWS via IAM Identity Center MFA; session host to center mgmt
- Drone Upload Isolation: Dedicated /32 reservation (10.4x.2.10) restricted to S3 endpoint; no drone ingress endpoint
